entities.name: Nicotinate phosphoribosyltransferase
observations: The 400-residue query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Escherichia coli UniProt entries C4ZQ57, B1X8N5, and P18133.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent synthesis of beta-nicotinate D-ribonucleotide from nicotinate and 5-phospho-D-ribose 1-phosphate.
Assigned EC 6.3.4.21 and Rhea reaction RHEA:36163.
A conserved histidine at reference position 220 is reported as an autocatalytically phosphohistidine.
Sequence-derived properties: 45.90 kDa, theoretical pI 6.21, predicted charge at pH 7 of -5.18, GRAVY -0.298.

entities.name: NAD+ salvage pathway
observations: Nicotinate phosphoribosyltransferase catalyzes the nicotinate-to-nicotinate ribonucleotide step of NAD+ biosynthesis via the salvage pathway.

entities.name: RHEA:36163
observations: 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + nicotinate + ATP + H2O yields nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + ADP + phosphate + diphosphate.
